description: Implement the complete frontend application with multi-tenant UI, student dashboard, teacher dashboard, admin/governance dashboard, AI tutor interface, and DPI integration pages. Includes the component library, offline-first capability with service workers, and responsive design for all device sizes.
steps: Create packages/ui/src/components/Layout/MainLayout.tsx - Main app layout with responsive sidebar navigation, tenant-branded header, breadcrumbs
Create packages/ui/src/components/Layout/DashboardLayout.tsx - Dashboard-specific layout with widgets grid, filters, date range pickers
Create packages/ui/src/components/Auth/LoginForm.tsx - Multi-tenant login form with tenant selector, SSO options, MFA support
Create packages/ui/src/components/Auth/RegisterForm.tsx - Registration form with role selection, tenant association, consent collection (DPDP)
Create packages/ui/src/components/Dashboard/StudentDashboard.tsx - Student view: learning path progress, upcoming assignments, AI tutor access, achievements, knowledge graph visualization
Create packages/ui/src/components/Dashboard/TeacherDashboard.tsx - Teacher view: class overview, student progress heatmap, AI co-pilot panel, assessment tools, content creation
Create packages/ui/src/components/Dashboard/AdminDashboard.tsx - Admin view: tenant management, user management, system health, usage analytics

Create packages/ui/src/components/Dashboard/GovernanceDashboard.tsx - Governance view: real-time metrics across all tenants, policy compliance, predictive analytics, enrollment stats, learning outcome trends
Create packages/ui/src/components/AI/TutorChat.tsx - AI tutor chat interface: conversational UI, language selector, voice input toggle, math/science renderer, step-by-step explanations
Create packages/ui/src/components/AI/LearningPath.tsx - Learning path visualization: interactive graph/timeline showing student progress through topics, prerequisite connections
Create packages/ui/src/components/AI/ContentCreator.tsx - Teacher content creation tool: AI-assisted lesson plan builder, quiz generator, resource recommender
Create packages/ui/src/components/Assessment/QuizPlayer.tsx - Assessment player: renders different question types (MCQ, short answer, matching, diagram-based), timer, progress indicator
Create packages/ui/src/components/Assessment/ResultsView.tsx - Assessment results: score breakdown, competency mapping, AI-generated feedback, improvement suggestions
Create packages/ui/src/components/DPI/APAARConnect.tsx - APAAR integration: student ID verification, profile sync, consent management
Create packages/ui/src/components/DPI/DigiLockerConnect.tsx - DigiLocker integration: document verification, certificate pull, credential display
Create packages/ui/src/components/DPI/ABCIntegration.tsx - Academic Bank of Credits: credit accumulation view, transfer requests, institution mapping
Create apps/web/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx - Login page using LoginForm component with tenant detection from subdomain
Create apps/web/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx - Registration page with multi-step onboarding flow
Create apps/web/app/(dashboard)/student/page.tsx - Student dashboard page with data fetching
Create apps/web/app/(dashboard)/teacher/page.tsx - Teacher dashboard page
Create apps/web/app/(dashboard)/admin/page.tsx - Admin dashboard page
Create apps/web/app/(dashboard)/governance/page.tsx - Governance dashboard page
Create apps/web/app/(learn)/tutor/page.tsx - AI tutor session page
Create apps/web/app/(learn)/path/page.tsx - Learning path page
Create apps/web/app/(assess)/quiz/[id]/page.tsx - Quiz taking page
Create apps/web/app/api/ route handlers for BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) pattern - proxying to Lambda APIs
Create apps/web/lib/api-client.ts - Type-safe API client with automatic tenant header injection, retry logic, offline queue
Create apps/web/lib/offline.ts - Offline-first utilities: service worker registration, IndexedDB caching, sync queue for offline operations
Create apps/web/public/sw.js - Service worker for offline caching: cache static assets, queue API calls when offline, sync when online
Create apps/web/lib/i18n.ts - Internationalization setup supporting Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Kannada with dynamic loading
Create apps/web/app/(dashboard)/student/__tests__/student-dashboard.test.tsx - Component tests for student dashboard
Create apps/web/app/(dashboard)/teacher/__tests__/teacher-dashboard.test.tsx - Component tests for teacher dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Next.js app builds successfully with all pages and components
All component TypeScript compiles without errors
UI component library exports all components correctly
Login flow handles multi-tenant detection from subdomain
Student, teacher, admin, and governance dashboards render with mock data
AI tutor chat interface renders with message bubbles, language selector
Offline service worker is properly configured for caching strategies
i18n supports at least Hindi and English with dynamic language switching
Component tests pass for dashboard components
